rings.name: PROPHET
rings.role: Specialization: forks, keystones, actives, mutations, axioms

subtrees.name: Execution
subtrees.fantasy: I touch something and it dies.
subtrees.input: Hunt HP fractions, not bodies: ignore healthy targets, sweep through weakened ones, time Gavel and Decimation for the moment the crowd dips under the Verdict line.
subtrees.hud: VERDICT 16% readout; enemies under the threshold get a red tick (reuses the Mark overlay path).

subtrees.name: Momentum
subtrees.input: Never stop: dash through enemies to prime them, chain dashes on kills, attack mid-stride.
subtrees.hud: The existing MOMENTUM row (the tree claims the manifestation noun) plus dash-charge pips.

subtrees.name: Bastion
subtrees.input: Walk into crowds, hold Guard to bank Force, release it through slashes or the rupture; standing still is rewarded (fights Momentum, pairs with Anchor Rite).
subtrees.hud: FORCE 64/100 meter (new noun, hue at least 12 degrees from ward).

subtrees.name: Precision
subtrees.input: Keep hitting the same target to Read it, line enemies up for pierce, stay far.
subtrees.hud: READ n counter; Read enemies show a reticle.

subtrees.name: Barrage
subtrees.input: Manage Heat: hold fire to climb tiers, kill to vent, back off before the Jam (or take Overclock and live hot).
subtrees.hud: HEAT bar with tier ticks at 25/50/75 and a red Jam zone.

subtrees.name: Ordnance
subtrees.fantasy: Prepare the field, then cause a disaster.
subtrees.input: Place things before enemies arrive: mines via dashes, Coordinates via cursor, then herd enemies into the timers.
subtrees.hud: COORD 2/3 plus mine count; telegraph circles are the language.

subtrees.name: Invocation
subtrees.input: Choose where to fight: near Sigils. Feed them kills, cast through them, Consecrate to reposition the arena.
subtrees.hud: SIGILS 3/5 plus Echo pips per Sigil.

subtrees.name: Distortion
subtrees.input: Gamble on purpose: flip the Coin before committing, cash Debt timing, let enemy projectiles fail.
subtrees.hud: DEBT 412 pending damage plus coin state.

subtrees.name: Dominion
subtrees.input: The cursor becomes a second body: decide where enemies go, compress them into impact radius, link them so one hit is many, hold ground.

rules: PRIMARY chains stop at generation 2; BRIDGE chains at generation 1.
Generation >= 1 never emits weapon_fired (a beat is not an attack) but does emit player_hit_landed.
no_self tags: AFTERIMAGE, RETARGET, RICOCHET, FRAGMENT, ORDNANCE_TRIGGER, SIGIL_SPAWN, TWICE, LINK_SHARE, CROSSFIRE.
Every generator checks allowed_children and the remaining budget before spawning.

nodes.name: Heavy Hand
nodes.effect: +6% melee damage per rank.

nodes.name: First Verdict
nodes.effect: Grants an execute threshold of 10%: a melee hit that leaves a normal enemy at or below 10% HP kills it, ignoring armor; overkill is captured.

nodes.name: Lower Bar
nodes.effect: +3% execute threshold per rank.

nodes.name: Spillover
nodes.effect: Overkill from a melee kill hits the nearest enemy within 90 px.

nodes.name: Clean Cut
nodes.effect: Executions refund 25% of slash cooldown per rank.

nodes.name: Elite Sentence
nodes.effect: The execute threshold applies to elites at half value.

nodes.name: Bloodletting
nodes.effect: Each execution grants +2% threshold for 4 s (5 stacks, refreshing).

nodes.name: Reservoir
nodes.effect: Spillover carries +25% of the overkill per rank (base 100%).

nodes.name: Quiet Sentence
nodes.effect: Your first hit on any enemy Sentences it for 3 s; a second melee hit on a Sentenced enemy executes at 2x threshold.

nodes.name: Collective Sentence
nodes.effect: Executions cleave: 60% of the victim's max HP to enemies in a 70 px arc.

nodes.name: Only the Weak Die
nodes.effect: +12% execute threshold.

nodes.name: Gavel
nodes.effect: Q: 0.25 s windup, then a 90 px radius strike at 3.0x slash damage that executes at 2x threshold inside the radius.
nodes.bounds: 6 s cooldown.

nodes.name: Public Execution
nodes.effect: Gavel overkill spills to every enemy within 120 px.

nodes.name: Swift Justice
nodes.effect: Gavel cooldown 6 -> 3.5 s, radius 90 -> 62 px.

nodes.name: Tithe of the Condemned
nodes.effect: +1 Follower per 10 Gavel executions (cap 20 per segment).

nodes.name: The Verdict Stands
nodes.effect: A Gavel that kills 5 or more grants +10% threshold for 6 s.

nodes.name: Violence Propagates
nodes.effect: Spillover applies to kills of any style you can produce.
nodes.price: Spill range 90 -> 60 px for non-melee kills.

nodes.name: DECIMATION
nodes.effect: V: 0.6 s stationary cast. Every normal enemy in the camera rect (+64 px) at or below the threshold dies; elites at or below half the threshold lose 50% max HP.
nodes.bounds: Max 150 targets (lowest HP fraction first); cannot touch bosses; 45 s cooldown.
nodes.op_cost: 1 Follower per 4 executed (min 5), previewed on the HUD before commit; refuses if unaffordable.

nodes.name: Light Feet
nodes.effect: +4% move speed per rank.

nodes.name: Stride
nodes.effect: Claims the Momentum meter: a dash adds +25% Momentum; slashes deal +10% damage per 25% Momentum (cap +40%).

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.effect: Dash cooldown -10% per rank.

nodes.name: Passing Blade
nodes.effect: The dash path (40 px wide) deals 0.6x slash damage and Primes enemies hit: their next melee hit taken is +50% (3 s).

nodes.name: Reach
nodes.effect: Slash arc radius +6 px per rank while Momentum is at or above 50%.

nodes.name: Kill Reset
nodes.effect: A melee kill cuts the remaining dash cooldown by 0.5 s (0.3 s ICD).

nodes.name: Running Cut
nodes.effect: Slash cooldown -5% per rank while moving.

nodes.name: Afterimage
nodes.effect: At Momentum >= 75% every slash repeats 0.25 s later at its origin for 50% (generation 1, NO_AFTERIMAGE).

nodes.name: Unbroken Motion
nodes.effect: Momentum does not decay for 2 s after a kill.

nodes.name: Thousand Cuts
nodes.effect: At Momentum >= 90% slashes echo once at 35% (generation 1).

nodes.name: Never Stop
nodes.effect: The dash gains a second charge (each 1.6 s, i-frames kept).
nodes.price: Slashes deal -30% while Momentum is below 25%.

nodes.name: Lunge
nodes.effect: Q: 240 px dash toward the aim point ending in a 1.5x 180-degree slash; counts as a dash (emits player_dashed).
nodes.bounds: 5 s cooldown.

nodes.name: Rebound
nodes.effect: A Lunge kill resets Lunge's cooldown (1.0 s ICD).

nodes.name: Wake
nodes.effect: The Lunge path deals Passing Blade at 1.0x, 60 px wide.

nodes.name: Shadow Step
nodes.effect: Lunge leaves an Afterimage that slashes twice over 0.5 s.

nodes.name: Blur
nodes.effect: After a Lunge: 0.6 s of 100% evasion and +25% move speed for 2 s.

nodes.name: NO DISTANCE BETWEEN US
nodes.effect: V: for 4 s each slash first teleports you to the nearest not-yet-hit normal or elite within 400 px (one hop per 0.12 s, 0.1 s i-frames per landing); ends early after 0.5 s without a target.
nodes.bounds: Cannot hop to bosses; 60 s cooldown; Momentum set to 0 on end.

nodes.name: Plate
nodes.effect: +3 armor per rank.

nodes.name: Stored Force
nodes.effect: Claims Force (cap 100): 40% of post-armor damage taken becomes Force (1 per 2 HP); a slash consumes up to 30 Force for +1% damage each.

nodes.name: Thick Skin
nodes.effect: Damage taken -4% per rank.

nodes.name: Vessel
nodes.effect: Force cap +20 per rank.

nodes.name: Surrounded
nodes.effect: +5% melee damage per enemy within 90 px at swing time (max +40%).

nodes.name: Immovable
nodes.effect: Displacement of the player is negated; each resisted knockback grants +8 Force and a 70 px 0.4x shockwave.

nodes.name: Slow Leak
nodes.effect: Force decay -3%/s per rank (base 6%/s after 3 s idle).

nodes.name: Return to Sender
nodes.effect: Enemy projectiles within 48 px during a slash are consumed: +5 Force and +10% slash damage each (max 5).

nodes.name: Pressure Vessel
nodes.effect: Force at cap auto-detonates: 160 px burst dealing Force x2.5, Force -> 0.

nodes.name: Overpressure
nodes.effect: Force may exceed its cap by 50%; slashes consume up to 60 Force; no auto-detonate.

nodes.name: Anvil
nodes.effect: Standing still for 0.5 s: damage taken -35% and Force gain x2.

nodes.name: Guard
nodes.effect: Hold Q: move -50%, damage taken -60%, damage taken becomes Force at 100%, projectiles touching a 72 px ring are consumed (+3 Force).
nodes.bounds: Drains 4 Force/s and ends at 0; no cooldown.

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.effect: Melee attackers striking the Guard ring are stunned 0.4 s (2 s ICD per enemy).

nodes.name: Counterweight
nodes.effect: Releasing Guard after 1 s fires a 2.0x 145-degree shockwave spending 50% Force.

nodes.name: Martyr's Ledger
nodes.effect: Guard also converts 2% max HP/s into +6 Force/s (never below 30% HP).

nodes.name: Living Rampart
nodes.effect: Guard's drain is removed; Force gain while guarding +50%.

nodes.name: Pressure Is Power
nodes.effect: Damage taken fills Force under any style; ranged and magic attacks may consume Force at half rate.

nodes.name: THE WORLD BREAKS FIRST
nodes.effect: V: needs 40+ Force. A rupture of radius 160 + 2.4 x Force (cap 400) deals Force x4 plus 30% of the damage you took in the last 10 s, knockback 600, stun 0.8 s; Force -> 0.
nodes.bounds: Bosses capped at 15% max HP; 30 s cooldown.
nodes.op_cost: 2% of current Followers, 4% if Force was at cap.

nodes.name: Rifling
nodes.effect: Projectile speed +10% per rank.

nodes.name: Read the Target
nodes.effect: The third consecutive hit on one enemy exposes a Weak Point for 4 s: hits deal x1.4 and report as critical (Lucky Crit rolls untouched).

nodes.name: Sharp Eye
nodes.effect: Weak Point multiplier +0.1 per rank.

nodes.name: Long Arm
nodes.effect: Range +60 px per rank.

nodes.name: Distance Is Contempt
nodes.effect: +8% damage per rank against targets 300+ px away.

nodes.name: Penetrator
nodes.effect: Pierce +1; +15% damage per enemy already pierced (max +60%).

nodes.name: Second Read
nodes.effect: Hits on a Weak Point gain +1 pierce; the enemy behind becomes Read after one hit.

nodes.name: Held Breath
nodes.effect: Weak Point duration +1 s per rank.

nodes.name: Impossible Shot
nodes.effect: A projectile expiring without a hit retargets once to the nearest enemy within 240 px (generation 1, NO_RETARGET).

nodes.name: Terminal Geometry
nodes.effect: After piercing a Read enemy the projectile bends up to 45 degrees toward the nearest other Read enemy within 200 px (once).

nodes.name: One Bullet
nodes.effect: Ranged cooldown 0.22 -> 0.44 s, damage x2.4, pierce +2.
nodes.price: Every extra-projectile source is disabled (the shotgun mutation included).

nodes.name: Ballistic Solution
nodes.effect: Q: 0.5 s stop, then one 5x infinite-pierce shot (speed 1400) along the line through the most enemies in a 60-degree aim cone.
nodes.bounds: 8 s cooldown.

nodes.name: Twin Solution
nodes.effect: Two lines (best and second best, at least 20 degrees apart).

nodes.name: Executioner's Solution
nodes.effect: Normals at or below 25% HP on the line die outright.

nodes.name: Quick Solution
nodes.effect: No stop; cooldown 8 -> 5 s; damage 5x -> 3.5x.

nodes.name: Perfect Solution
nodes.effect: Every enemy hit by the Solution becomes Read; kills refund 2 s of its cooldown.

nodes.name: Nothing Is Wasted
nodes.effect: Any projectile or magic impact that hits nothing retargets once to the nearest enemy within 200 px (generation +1, NO_RETARGET).

nodes.name: LINE OF JUDGEMENT
nodes.effect: V: 1.0 s designation (enemies at 15% time scale while you aim) computes up to three lines maximizing on-screen intersections; on release each fires as an 8x hitscan beam (24 px wide) 0.2 s apart.
nodes.bounds: Max 60 targets per line; bosses capped at 10% max HP per line; 50 s cooldown.

nodes.name: Trigger Discipline
nodes.effect: Ranged cooldown -4% per rank.

nodes.name: Heat
nodes.effect: Claims Heat: +6 per shot, decays 15/s after 0.6 s idle. At 25: +10% rate; 50: +20% and +1 pellet; 75: +30% and +2; 100: Jam for 1.2 s and Heat -> 0.

nodes.name: Heat Sink
nodes.effect: Jam duration -0.2 s per rank.

nodes.name: Fragmentation
nodes.effect: Ranged kills release 2 fragments (generation 1, 30%, seeking the nearest enemy within 140 px, NO_FRAGMENT).

nodes.name: Coolant
nodes.effect: Heat decay +3/s per rank.

nodes.name: Kill Reload
nodes.effect: Kills vent 8 Heat per rank.

nodes.name: Ricochet
nodes.effect: Projectiles bounce once toward the nearest enemy within 160 px at 60% (generation 1, NO_RICOCHET).

nodes.name: Ricochets Ricochet
nodes.effect: +1 bounce (generation 2, budget 2), -20% per bounce.

nodes.name: ONE WEAPON, INFINITE BULLETS
nodes.effect: The 75 tier becomes +60% rate and +3 pellets.

nodes.name: INFINITE WEAPONS, ONE TARGET
nodes.effect: At Heat >= 50 every third shot also fires from a Crossfire point on a 380 px ring, aimed at your target (generation 1, CROSSFIRE, 70%).

nodes.name: Overclock
nodes.effect: The Jam is removed; Heat cap 150 with a fourth tier at 100 (+40% rate, +3 pellets).
nodes.price: Damage taken +35% and decay only 5/s while Heat is 100 or more.

nodes.name: Suppressive Burst
nodes.effect: Q: 1.5 s at +150% fire rate with no Heat gain; ends by setting Heat to 75.
nodes.bounds: 10 s cooldown.

nodes.name: Sustained
nodes.effect: Burst lasts 2.5 s instead of 1.5 s.

nodes.name: Vented
nodes.effect: Burst ends at Heat 25 instead of 75, venting a 120 px 1.0x burn nova.

nodes.name: Enfilade
nodes.effect: Every Burst shot ricochets (+1, generation budget respected).

nodes.name: Belt-Fed
nodes.effect: Burst kills extend it by 0.15 s each (max +2 s).

nodes.name: Heat Is Universal
nodes.effect: Slashes and casts add +4 Heat; Heat rate tiers apply to every style's attack cooldown.
nodes.price: The Jam applies to every style.

nodes.name: ABSOLUTE SUPPRESSION
nodes.effect: V: for 5 s every shot you fire spawns 3 more from three rotating Crossfire points on a 420 px ring (generation 1, CROSSFIRE, 60%, no fragments or ricochets); Heat is frozen.
nodes.bounds: Cap 300 secondary shots; Crossfire never targets bosses; 60 s cooldown.
nodes.op_cost: 1 Follower per 20 shots spawned (min 8), charged on end.

nodes.name: Blast Radius
nodes.effect: Ordnance blast radius +8% per rank.

nodes.name: Impact Fuse
nodes.effect: Every fifth ranged hit drops a Shell at the impact point (0.6 s delay, radius 80, 1.8x, generation 1, ORDNANCE, NO_ORDNANCE_TRIGGER).

nodes.name: Shorter Fuse

nodes.name: Caltrops
nodes.effect: Dashing drops a Mine at the start point (arms in 0.5 s, radius 70, 1.5x, 12 s life, max 6).

nodes.name: Magazine
nodes.effect: Max mines +2 per rank.

nodes.name: Fracture
nodes.effect: Blast hits apply Fractured: +6% damage taken per stack (max 5, 5 s).

nodes.name: Secondary Detonation

nodes.name: Heavier Shells
nodes.effect: Blast damage +10% per rank.

nodes.name: Saturation Coordinates
nodes.effect: Every 3 s the densest cluster (6+ enemies within 100 px, scanned at 10 Hz) is auto-designated: 3 Shells over 1 s.

nodes.name: Walking Barrage
nodes.effect: While moving, a Shell lands 120 px behind you every 0.8 s.

nodes.name: Beacon Doctrine
nodes.effect: Elites hit by three blasts become Beacons: a Shell strikes them every 1.5 s until death (max 3 Beacons).
nodes.price: Mines and Impact Fuse deal -50% to normals.

nodes.name: Designate
nodes.effect: Q: place a Coordinate at the cursor (max 3, 15 s). Press on an existing one: it receives 4 Shells over 1.6 s at 2.0x.
nodes.bounds: 12 s cooldown from firing.

nodes.name: Saturation
nodes.effect: 4 -> 7 Shells, scattered over 160 px.

nodes.name: Guidance
nodes.effect: Coordinates track the nearest elite; 4 -> 3 Shells at 3.0x.

nodes.name: Cascade
nodes.effect: Each Designate kill adds a Shell to the sequence (max +6).

nodes.name: Fire for Effect
nodes.effect: Coordinates persist after firing; cooldown 12 -> 8 s.

nodes.name: TOTAL FIRE MISSION
nodes.effect: V: 1.2 s grid telegraph over the screen, then 24 Shells over 4 s on a density-biased stratified grid (3.0x, radius 110, 0.16 s stagger).
nodes.bounds: 90 px player-safe radius per Shell; bosses capped at 12% max HP total; 75 s cooldown.
nodes.op_cost: 6% of current Followers (min 20) plus 1 per Cascade Shell.

nodes.name: Wider Sigil
nodes.effect: Magic impact radius +6 px per rank.

nodes.name: Leave a Sigil
nodes.effect: Every fourth impact leaves a Sigil (8 s, max 3) that pulses a 0.35x 48 px impact every 1.0 s (generation 1, SIGIL, NO_SIGIL_SPAWN).

nodes.name: Endure
nodes.effect: Sigil life +3 s per rank.

nodes.name: Congregation
nodes.effect: Max Sigils +1 per rank.

nodes.name: Fed by Death
nodes.effect: Kills within 90 px of a Sigil grow it: +5% pulse damage and +2 px radius (max +100% / +40 px).

nodes.name: Echo Shrine
nodes.effect: Casting within 70 px of a Sigil stores an Echo (max 3), released as full impacts when it expires or is triggered.

nodes.name: Warm Circle
nodes.effect: +6% magic damage per rank per Sigil within 150 px (max 3 counted).

nodes.name: Pulse Rate
nodes.effect: Sigil pulse interval -0.1 s per rank.

nodes.name: Autonomous Invocation
nodes.effect: Sigils aim: pulses become 0.5x impacts thrown at the nearest enemy within 220 px.

nodes.name: Recursive Ritual
nodes.effect: A fully grown Sigil splits once: a child at 60% (generation 2, budget 1, cannot split) at the nearest cluster within 200 px.

nodes.name: Inherit the Word
nodes.effect: Sigil pulses run apply_to_magic_impact and fire player_hit_landed as yours, so item on-hit rules trigger (0.5 s ICD per Sigil).
needs: as-player hook proxy with SIGIL origin

nodes.name: Consecrate
nodes.effect: Q: place a Sigil at the cursor (within 260 px) now and pulse every Sigil immediately.
nodes.bounds: 7 s cooldown.

nodes.name: Great Sigil
nodes.effect: The Consecrated Sigil has 1.5x radius and damage and counts as 2 toward the cap.

nodes.name: Beacon of Ruin
nodes.effect: Consecrate also releases every stored Echo.

nodes.name: Wandering Sigil
nodes.effect: The Consecrated Sigil follows you at 120 px/s (one at a time).

nodes.name: Liturgy
nodes.effect: Cooldown 7 -> 4 s; Consecrated Sigils never expire while you are within 200 px.

nodes.name: THE HOST
nodes.effect: V: for 6 s every Sigil duplicates once (60 px offset, generation 2, cannot grow or split, dies with the Host) and all Sigils pulse at 3x rate; Host copies release their Echoes on end.
nodes.bounds: Cap 12 Sigils on the field; bosses capped at 10% max HP total; 70 s cooldown.
nodes.op_cost: 4% of current Followers (min 15) plus 1 per Sigil duplicated.

nodes.name: Improbable
nodes.effect: Luck +6% per rank.

nodes.name: Twice
nodes.effect: 12% chance (Luck-scaled, cap 20%) that an impact bursts again 0.15 s later at 50% (generation 1, NO_TWICE).

nodes.name: Lingering Wrong
nodes.effect: Durations of statuses you apply +10% per rank.

nodes.name: Misfire
nodes.effect: Enemy projectiles within 90 px have a 15%/s chance each to be consumed (10 Hz poll, random subset).

nodes.name: Denial
nodes.effect: Misfire chance +5% per rank.

nodes.name: Causal Debt
nodes.effect: Each hit re-applies 20% of its damage after 2.0 s (deferred ledger, max 3 pending per enemy; voided on death).

nodes.name: Interest
nodes.effect: Debt +5% per rank.

nodes.name: Contradiction
nodes.effect: An enemy holding two or more of burn, stun, slow, Fractured, Primed, Read or Debt takes +15% from you.

nodes.name: Revision
nodes.effect: Once per 12 s a hit of 25%+ max HP is undone (healed back, 0.5 s i-frames).

nodes.name: Inheritance
nodes.effect: Pending Debt on a dying enemy transfers to the nearest enemy within 120 px (generation +1, budget 2).

nodes.name: Loaded Dice
nodes.effect: Lucky Crit cap 8% -> 16%, multiplier 1.5x -> 2.0x.
nodes.price: Every failed Luck roll costs 1% max HP (0.2 s ICD).
needs: Lucky Crit cap and multiplier as parameters

nodes.name: Coin
nodes.effect: Q: a 50/50 flip (Luck-biased up to 65/35). HEADS: 3 s of guaranteed Lucky Crits and Debt timers at 0.3 s. TAILS: -10% current HP and +40% magic damage for 3 s.
nodes.bounds: 9 s cooldown.

nodes.name: Weighted
nodes.effect: HEADS bias +10%.

nodes.name: Double or Nothing
nodes.effect: TAILS may be re-flipped within 1 s; a second TAILS costs 20% HP.

nodes.name: House Edge
nodes.effect: Either result consumes all enemy projectiles within 160 px.

nodes.name: Rigged
nodes.effect: Cooldown 9 -> 6 s; HEADS refunds 25% of the Revelation cooldown (once per 30 s).

nodes.name: Effects Have Memory
nodes.effect: Statuses you apply under any style have a 20% chance to reapply once at 50% duration when they expire.

nodes.name: CONSENSUS FAILURE
nodes.effect: V: for 4 s every Luck check you make succeeds, Twice always fires, Debt applies instantly, enemy projectiles within 220 px are consumed, and enemy melee against you misses.
nodes.bounds: Explicitly excluded: cooldown resets, item internal cooldowns, boss arena mechanics; generation budgets enforced. 90 s cooldown, then 6 s of forced Luck failure (banks Misfortune for Broken Providence on purpose).

nodes.name: Gravity Well
nodes.effect: Impacts pull enemies in a 120 px ring inward by 40 px and slow them 30% for 1.5 s.

nodes.name: Heavier
nodes.effect: Pull +10 px per rank.

nodes.name: Lingering Weight
nodes.effect: Slow +0.5 s per rank.

nodes.name: Collision
nodes.effect: Pulled enemies ending within 14 px of each other take 0.4x impact damage each (once per pull, max 20 pairs).

nodes.name: Bind
nodes.effect: Enemies hit by one impact become Linked (up to 6, 6 s): Linked enemies share slows and stuns.

nodes.name: Longer Chain
nodes.effect: Link +2 s per rank; rank 2 also raises members 6 -> 8.

nodes.name: Collective Burden
nodes.effect: 25% of damage dealt to a Linked enemy is copied to each partner (generation 1, NO_LINK_SHARE, max 5).

nodes.name: Crushing
nodes.effect: +5% magic damage per rank per enemy within 60 px of the impact centre (max +40%).

nodes.name: Singularity
nodes.effect: An impact on 6+ enemies collapses them to its centre with a 0.3 s stun.

nodes.name: Forced Orbit
nodes.effect: Pulled enemies orbit you at 110 px for 2 s, unable to attack (velocity override).

nodes.name: Sovereign Ground
nodes.effect: Standing still for 1 s leaves a 90 px zone (max 2, 6 s): enemies inside are slowed 50% and take +20% damage.

nodes.name: Compel
nodes.effect: Q (aimed): a 200 px cone; every enemy in it is dragged 140 px toward the cursor point and stunned 0.4 s.
nodes.bounds: 8 s cooldown.

nodes.name: Compel: Ring
nodes.effect: Compel becomes a 220 px circle around the cursor.

nodes.name: Compel: Chain
nodes.effect: Every pulled enemy is Linked together (cap 12 for that batch).

nodes.name: Compel: Repulse
nodes.effect: Hold to invert: shove 260 px; 0.6x on collision.

nodes.name: Absolute Compel
nodes.effect: Cooldown 8 -> 5 s; pulled enemies are Subjugated (+10% damage taken, 3 s).

nodes.name: KNEEL
nodes.effect: V: every normal on screen is pulled to the cursor point at 900 px/s for 0.8 s and held 2.0 s; elites are slowed 70% and held 1.0 s.
nodes.bounds: Bosses unaffected; max 300 targets; released with a 0.5 s no-attack stumble; 60 s cooldown.
nodes.op_cost: 5% of current Followers (min 15) plus 1 per 25 pulled.

nodes.name: Sharpen
nodes.effect: +3% melee damage per rank.

nodes.name: Verdict
nodes.effect: +0.5% execute threshold per rank.

nodes.name: Ledger
nodes.effect: Force cap +5 per rank.

nodes.name: Rifling
nodes.effect: +2% projectile speed and range per rank.

nodes.name: Judgement
nodes.effect: +4% Active and Revelation damage per rank.

nodes.name: Barrel

nodes.name: Dominion
nodes.effect: +2% impact radius per rank.

nodes.name: Invocation
nodes.effect: Sigil life +0.5 s and pulse damage +2% per rank.

nodes.name: Consensus

nodes.name: Witness of the Sign
nodes.effect: Grants the magic core impact as a tree-triggerable secondary attack (never input-triggered).
nodes.bounds: Needs any Revelation of your style and a peak congregation of 5,000,000.

nodes.name: INCARNATE
